mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pu_certificate (student_id, certificate_type, issued_date, status, created_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{certificateType}, #{issuedDate}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id as studentId, certificate_type as certificateType, issued_date as issuedDate, status, created_at as createdAt FROM pu_certificate WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, student_id as studentId, certificate_type as certificateType, issued_date as issuedDate, status, created_at as createdAt FROM pu_certificate WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, student_id as studentId, certificate_type as certificateType, issued_date as issuedDate, status, created_at as createdAt FROM pu_certificate WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND certificate_type = #{certificateType} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
